decisions.reason: Retaining AXP2101 selects the integrated board's power-management component but does not change its single-board architecture, functional consolidation, or functionality-preservation requirements.
Keeping AXP2101 does not revoke or alter the existing cost and JLCPCB Basic-component preferences, which already apply only wherever practical.
The source confirms the component for the new integrated-board design and does not change the existing main-board OR-ing topology or either of its power sources.
Retaining AXP2101 does not change the established DCDC1 setpoint, I2C configuration, downstream target, or diode-drop compensation.
The power-management component decision does not change the existing main-board connector inventory or connector architecture.
The AXP2101 decision has no necessary effect on the LED-board power and data pin ordering.
The source retains AXP2101 for the integrated board but does not modify the existing power-board VMID/VSYS or thermal-pad topology requirements.
The selected power-management component does not change the current-monitor IC, monitored rails, measurement position, or channel allocation.
Retaining AXP2101 is consistent with the existing protection design but does not change any battery-protection threshold or protection mode.
The source does not change the LEDs' 3.3V supply, separate switching, direct data drive, or level-shifter decision.
Keeping AXP2101 does not change the separate MT3608 boost converter's enable control, GPIO, output, or powered loads.
The AXP2101 decision concerns integrated-board power management and does not resolve or alter the standalone USB LDO requirement or its unresolved 2A adequacy.
